hints.title: Start Time Chronological Ordering
hints.text: Sort all intervals by their start times. This simplifies conflict checking to adjacent intervals.

hints.title: Adjacent End Boundary Overlap Guard
hints.text: Check whether the end time of the current meeting strictly exceeds the start time of the next scheduled meeting.

hints.title: Linear Consecutive Interval Scan
hints.text: Sort intervals by start time. Iterate through consecutive pairs from index zero to n minus two; if intervals[i][1] is strictly greater than intervals[i+1][0], return false. If loop finishes, return true.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair of meetings for overlap requires quadratic O(N^2) comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by start time reduces the problem from all pairs to adjacent pairs in O(N log N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that adjacent intervals after sorting are sufficient to detect all conflicts.
